The one recommended for you and all the others.

La tecla del botón de tu barra con esa h.en: The key of the button on your bar with that ability, on the icon.

La tecla que usabas en tu otro addon de.en: The key you used in your other fishing addon (%s) now fishes with Alfa.

La trituradora tira a la gente: vuelve a.en: The shredder knocks people around: get its attention back fast.

La tuya tiene %d semanas: salen seguido..en: Yours is %d weeks old: updates come often.

Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz gobierna a los.en: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner rules the Forsaken. She was Ranger-General of Quel'Thalas before Arthas killed her.

Lanza bolas de fuego y fuego a su alrede.en: He casts fireballs and fire around him: interrupt him and, if ranged, stay away.

Lanza bombas de humo que aturden: sal de.en: He throws smoke bombs that stun: get out of the smoke.

Lanza enredaderas que tumban a todos los.en: He casts vines that knock down everyone near him: ranged players, stay back.

Lanza fuego a su alrededor: si peleas de.en: He sends out fire around him: ranged players, stay away from him.

Lanza hechizos de tierra y pone tótems:.en: He casts earth spells and drops totems: break the totems first.

Lanza metal fundido: si no tanqueas, no.en: He throws molten metal: if you're not the tank, don't stand next to him.

Lanza rayos y se puede curar: interrumpe.en: She casts lightning and can heal herself: interrupt her spells.

Lanza ráfagas arcanas: interrúmpelo..en: He casts arcane bursts: interrupt him.

Lanza sombras: interrúmpelo..en: He casts shadow spells: interrupt him.

Lanza telarañas y una maldición: quita l.en: He shoots webs and casts a curse: remove the curse if you can.

Lanza tormentas de arena que se mueven p.en: He creates sandstorms that move around the room: don't stand in them.

Lanza tu hechizo más fuerte desde lejos.en: Cast your strongest spell from afar and finish with the instant ones.

Lanza tu hechizo más fuerte primero y re.en: Cast your strongest spell first and finish with a shock.

Lanza una nube de veneno hacia adelante:.en: She breathes a poison cloud in front of her: turn her away from the group.

Lanza una red que deja quieto a un jugad.en: He throws a net that holds a player in place: not a problem, keep attacking.

Lanza veneno a todos: quita el veneno si.en: He hits everyone with poison: remove it if you can.

Las Estepas Ardientes se incendiaron cua.en: The Burning Steppes caught fire when Ragnaros awoke, and their embers still haven't gone out.

Las Islas del Eco eran el hogar de los L.en: The Echo Isles were the Darkspear's home until the witch doctor Zalazane enslaved many with his voodoo and the rest had to move to the mainland.

Las Minas de la Muerte esconden el refug.en: The Deadmines hide VanCleef's hideout... and even a pirate ship.

Las aguas de nivel 20 a 35. El rango Exp.en: Level 20 to 35 waters. Expert is learned from the book the Booty Bay fisherman sells.

Las centinelas de Vallefresno pelean sin.en: Ashenvale's sentinels fight tirelessly against the Warsong orc loggers.

Las centinelas domestican sables de hiel.en: The sentinels tame frostsabers in Winterspring and trust them only to those who earn their respect.

Las criaturas que invocan los enemigos p.en: Creatures enemies summon for a while.

Las cuentas de prueba no pueden comparti.en: Trial accounts cannot share: the game does not allow it.

Las dos se suben solas mientras matas y.en: Both level up on their own while you kill and travel, and what you gather sells well: gold for your mount and your abilities.

Las esquinas de la pantalla se oscurecen.en: The screen corners darken gradually, like in a photo.

Las excavaciones de los enanos despertar.en: The dwarves' excavations woke up the troggs, and now Thelsamar has to watch out for them.

Las líneas que escribe Anunciar en el ch.en: The lines Announce writes in your group or raid chat.

Las marcas de la manada también en el mi.en: The pack's marks on the minimap too, not only on the world map.

Las marcas en el suelo de hechizos y áre.en: Ground markings of spells and areas. Turning them off hides combat warnings: better keep them on.

Las mejores misiones que ya puedes tomar.en: The best quests you can already take near you, in the shortest order.

Las mesetas de Cima del Trueno están uni.en: Thunder Bluff's mesas are linked by bridges, and you ride elevators up to the city.

Las metas se cumplen solas al hacerlas;.en: Goals are met by themselves when you do them; notes you mark yourself. Order them as you like.

Las misiones grises dan poca XP. Entréga.en: Gray quests give little XP. Turn them in and move on.

Las misiones previas y el nivel que pide.en: The earlier quests and the level it needs, so you can take it.

Las misiones que más experiencia dan cer.en: The quests near you that give the most experience.

Las monturas de otra raza de tu bando pu.en: Mounts of another race of your faction may require reputation with its city: your own race's always work.

Las ondas al caminar o nadar en el agua..en: Ripples when walking or swimming in water.

Las pestañas toman la letra y los colore.en: The tabs take the style's font and colours; the selected one gets the accent line. In Classic WoW the game's own tabs stay.

Las profesiones de recolección dan oro d.en: Gathering professions make gold from level 1. Herbs or mining!

Las que se hacen una sola vez..en: The ones you do only once.

Las que se repiten cada día..en: The ones that repeat every day.

Las que se repiten cada semana..en: The ones that repeat every week.

Las que vienen después, más pequeñas a l.en: The ones that come next, smaller, to the right.

Las rutas y los planes que armas en la p.en: The routes and plans you build on Alfa's Route page.

Las sesiones, las zonas y los objetos de.en: This character's sessions, zones and items.

Las ventanas de chat, sus pestañas y la.en: The chat windows, their tabs and the edit box take the style you choose below and change with it. Turning it off brings back the usual chat, without a /reload.

Lee el precio más bajo de cada objeto en.en: Reads the lowest price of every item in the whole auction house. It buys and posts nothing. It can be used every 15 minutes.

Lee los objetivos de la misión antes de.en: Read the quest objectives before heading out: you'll save trips.

Letras grandes en el centro de la pantal.en: Big letters in the middle of the screen when the boss does something important.

Libera tu sello en el enemigo: daño extr.en: Unleash your seal on the enemy: extra damage.

Limpien a sus ayudantes antes de empezar.en: Clear his helpers before you start on him.

Listo: te abrimos un susurro para %s. Re.en: Done: we opened a whisper to %s. Check the message and press Enter.

Listo: tu mapa también funciona en los m.en: Done: your map also works on Blizzard's frames.

Llama a varios lobos al empezar: usen at.en: He calls several wolves at the start: use area attacks or kill the wolves first.

Llega a la maestría Diestro con una capt.en: Reach Skilled mastery with a catch.

Llega con %d puntos del legado ganados e.en: Reach %d Legacy points earned on your account.

Llega con ayudantes naga: mátenlos prime.en: She comes with naga helpers: kill them first.

Llega con guardias: tírenlos aparte si p.en: He comes with guards: pull them away from him if you can.

Llega con lobos: elimínenlos primero..en: He comes with wolves: kill them first.

Llega con su perro: una persona debe tan.en: He brings his dog: one person tanks each, or kill the dog first.

Llegas al rival con ira para pegar de in.en: You reach your opponent with rage to hit right away.

Llegaste al final; quedaron %d pasos sin.en: You reached the end; %d steps were left undone.

Lleva al máximo la distancia de la cámar.en: Sets the camera distance (the one in Options > Controls) to its maximum. Turning it off brings yours back.

Lleva siempre un sello puesto aunque est.en: Always keep a seal up even while healing.

Lleva siempre vendas y comida: descansar.en: Always carry bandages and food: resting a little and safely is faster than dying.

Llevas %d de %d pasos. El rastreador te.en: You are %d of %d steps in. The tracker tells you the next one and the arrow takes you there.

Llevas %s. La manada te espera aunque te.en: It's been %s. The pack will wait for you if you take a breather.

Llevas %s. Si cierras sesión en una posa.en: It's been %s. If you log out at an inn, you earn rested XP.

Llévame a la subasta.en: Take me to the auction house

Lo apagas o lo enciendes cuando quieras.en: Turn it off or on any time in Pack > La Jauría.

Lo enseña un instructor de la profesión.en: Taught by a trainer of the profession

Lo gris y lo que marcaste como chatarra..en: Grey items and what you marked as junk. Never what you marked to keep or what a quest needs.

Lo justo para abrir la siguiente fila..en: Just enough to open the next row.

Lo mejor de los dos lados. Si no sabes c.en: The best of both sides. If you don't know which to pick, pick this one.

Lo menos que espera Lya entre un consejo.en: The least Lya waits between one tip and the next. Important things don't wait.

Lo menos que espera Lya entre una histor.en: The least Lya waits between one story and the next. Never in combat or dungeons.

Lo más ligero: para equipos modestos o p.en: The lightest: for modest PCs or to raise FPS in big fights.

Lo nuevo de esta versión, en pocas palab.en: What this version brings, in a few words.

Lo pequeño que hace el juego más cómodo:.en: The small things that make the game more comfortable: quests, flights, minimap, chat and bars in Alfa's style, frames, tooltip, dressing room, camera and sounds.

Lo pones al empezar a pelear..en: You put it on as the fight starts.

Lo que Alfa acepta, rechaza o comparte s.en: What Alfa accepts, declines or shares by itself. Hold Shift to decide yourself at that moment.

Lo que Lya sabe de aquí.en: What Lya knows about this place

Lo que buscas en la Enciclopedia.en: What you look up in the Encyclopedia

Lo que comparte alguien de tu grupo con.en: What someone in your group shares with Alfa lands in your markers, with their name, and lets you know so you can follow it.

Lo que cuentan las misiones que vas toma.en: What the quests you take have to say

Lo que el menú del juego no enseña, a tu.en: What the game menu doesn't show, your way

Lo que encuentras en la manada.en: What you'll find in the pack

Lo que este personaje lleva en las mazmo.en: What this character has done in dungeons: saved by itself as you defeat bosses and pick up loot.

Lo que ganaste la última vez que jugaste.en: What you gained the last time you played this character.

Lo que más conviene ahora.en: What pays off most right now

Lo que quieras contarle al desarrollador.en: Whatever you'd like to tell Alfa's developer.

Lo que quieras; la marcas tú cuando la h.en: Anything you like; you mark it when you do it.

Lo que se queda la subasta de cada venta.en: What the auction house keeps from each sale. Usually 5% at your faction's and 15% at the neutral one. It is an estimate.

Lo que sigue en tu build no está en tu á.en: What comes next in your build isn't in your tree

Lo que sigue pide este nivel: hasta ento.en: What comes next needs this level: until then, the guide does not send you there.

Lo que te pasa a ti: curación recibida,.en: What happens to you: healing received, dodges, resources. May need /reload the first time.

Lo que tu build necesita de tu equipo y.en: What your build needs from your gear and where to get it.

Lo que tu clase se pone antes de pelear.en: What your class puts on before a fight is active.

Lo que tu profesión de recolección junta.en: What your gathering profession collects best.

Lo que ya tienes en el banco.en: What you already have in the bank

Lo revisa el desarrollador de Alfa. En e.en: Alfa's developer reads it. Nobody else in that channel sees your message. If you're not on the Discord yet, join with the invite above.

Lo sigues: el rastreador te muestra la m.en: You follow it: the tracker shows the current goal and the arrow goes to each place.

Los Claros de Tirisfal guardan las ruina.en: Tirisfal Glades holds the ruins of Lordaeron, Arthas's kingdom. Beneath its old capital, the Forsaken built the Undercity.

Los PNJ dejan de hablar al saludarte o a.en: NPCs stop talking when they greet you or give you quests. It also mutes error speech.

Los Páramos de Poniente eran el granero.en: Westfall was Stormwind's breadbasket; today many of its farms are in the hands of the Defias Brotherhood.

Los Renegados son no-muertos que recuper.en: The Forsaken are undead who regained their free will when the Lich King's power weakened.

Los ajustes de los recordatorios están e.en: The reminder settings are in the Alfa window's search.

Los botones de otros addons alrededor de.en: Other addons' buttons around the minimap (Alfa's too) only show while the pointer is over it.

Los cementerios del Ocaso están llenos d.en: Duskwood's graveyards are full of undead raised by necromancers hiding in the forest.

Los centauros dicen descender de Zaetar,.en: The centaurs claim descent from Zaetar, son of the demigod Cenarius, and Theradras, the earth princess. Their clans fight each other almost as much as everyone else.

Los cinco Aspectos Dragón recibieron su.en: The five Dragon Aspects received their power from the titans: Alexstrasza life, Ysera dreams, Nozdormu time, Malygos magic and Neltharion the earth.

Los clanes Gelkis y Magram de Desolace p.en: Desolace's Gelkis and Magram clans fight each other, and both look for allies among adventurers.

Los cruzados escarlata vienen en grupos.en: Scarlet crusaders come in groups and some heal: interrupt the healers.

Los críticos hacen el doble de daño y al.en: Crits deal double damage, and give warriors more rage.

Los datos de Alfa no traen botín propio.en: Alfa's data has no loot of their own for its bosses.

Los datos de las mazmorras se cargan fue.en: Dungeon data loads out of combat. This page fills in by itself when the fight ends.

Los datos del mundo (Codex) no están dis.en: World data (Codex) isn't available: pools, quests and sources are missing.

Los datos del mundo de Alfa están apagad.en: Alfa's world data is turned off: enable "Alfa Codex" in the AddOns list.

Los datos son del medidor oficial del ju.en: The data comes from the game's official meter: you, your group or raid, and their pets.

Los dioses antiguos son seres de antes d.en: The Old Gods are beings older than the titans, imprisoned beneath Azeroth's soil. C'Thun and Yogg-Saron whisper to anyone who'll listen.

Los dragones verdes siguen vigilando el.en: The green dragons still watch over the sunken temple so no one calls Hakkar again.

Los elfos de la noche fueron inmortales.en: The night elves were immortal thanks to Nordrassil, until they sacrificed it to defeat Archimonde at Mount Hyjal.

Los enanos Hierro Negro tomaron Dun Modr.en: The Dark Iron dwarves took Dun Modr, north of the Wetlands, and harass anyone crossing the bridge.

Los enemigos de tus misiones marcados so.en: Your quest enemies marked on their nameplates and quest items glowing in your bags.

Los enemigos lanzan radiación y veneno:.en: Enemies use radiation and poison: bring health potions.

Los enemigos más débiles, que el juego m.en: The weakest enemies, which the game marks with a minus sign.

Los furbolgs Fauces de Madera son de los.en: The Timbermaw furbolgs are among the few who haven't been corrupted; their tunnels lead to Winterspring and Moonglade.

Los geomantes lanzan fuego y ponen tótem.en: Geomancers cast fire and drop totems: interrupt them and break the totems.

Los goblins de la fundición tienen ayuda.en: The goblins in the foundry have helpers nearby: look around before you attack.

Los grifos (o dragones) a los lados de l.en: The gryphons (or wyverns) at the sides of the main bar.

Los instructores y vendedores de pesca s.en: Fishing trainers and vendors show on the map and minimap.

Los jefes opcionales y raros se descubre.en: Optional and rare bosses are revealed when you finish the dungeon.

Los jefes se descubren al vencerlos: su.en: Bosses are revealed as you defeat them: their name and loot stay hidden until then. Their tips can always be shown.

Los kóbolds de las minas de Elwynn cuida.en: The kobolds in Elwynn's mines guard their candles like treasure: underground, light is everything.

Los lobos que se dejan ver en el mapa. U.en: The wolves who let themselves be seen on the map. Click their mark and the arrow takes you.

Los lobos que usan Alfa y se dejan ver e.en: The wolves who use Alfa and let themselves be seen on the map, and your group, who you see now.

Los logros de la manada: se ganan pescan.en: The pack's achievements: earned by fishing, cooking what you catch and exploring new waters. Each one is announced only once.

Los lugares que pides ver en el mapa des.en: The places you ask to see on the map from the Encyclopedia.

Los maestros de vuelo de tu facción y lo.en: Flight masters of your faction and neutral ones: green when known, amber with "?" when you still have to discover them. Click: follow it with the arrow.

Los marcos se mueven fuera de combate..en: Frames can only be moved out of combat.

Los marcos, fondos, botones y letras del.en: The game's own frames, backgrounds, buttons and fonts, with gold titles.

Los mismos marcadores de misiones en el.en: The same quest markers on the minimap.

Los nagas y sátiros lanzan escarcha y ra.en: Nagas and satyrs cast frost and lightning: interrupt the casters first.

Los nodos de la zona que miras, con su n.en: The nodes of the zone you are looking at; hover one for its name, level and how often you gathered it. Click one: the arrow takes you there.

Los nodos que se pisarían en pantalla va.en: Nodes that would overlap on screen share one pin with their count. Zoom in and they split.

Los nodos que tienes cerca. El punto del.en: The nodes near you. The game's tracking dot tells whether something is there now.

Los nodos que trae Alfa. Sin esto solo v.en: The nodes Alfa ships with. Without it you only see the ones you found.

Los números de lo que curas encima de qu.en: Your healing numbers above whoever receives it.

Los números de tu daño encima de quien g.en: Your damage numbers above whoever you hit.

Los objetos se juntan al final de tus bo.en: Items gather at the end of your bags instead of the start.

Los orcos Roca Negra de Rend se adueñaro.en: Rend's Blackrock orcs took over the mountain's summit and call it home.

Los orcos llegaron de Draenor corrompido.en: The orcs came from Draenor corrupted by Mannoroth's blood. Thrall freed them from the internment camps and founded the new Horde.

Los otros %d puntos del plan llegan con.en: The plan's other %d points come with your next levels.

Los portales a pie que puedes usar, con.en: The walk-in portals you can use, with where they lead.

Los precios cambian: después de estos dí.en: Prices change: after these many days Alfa reminds you to scan again.

Los puntos de ruta que ponen otros addon.en: Waypoints other addons set, and /way, point Alfa's arrow. An addon that expects another waypoint addon's settings may not work with this on.

Los puntos que ganas en la cuenta tambié.en: The points you earn on your account also fill the Legacy Reward Track: cosmetic rewards, no gameplay advantage. At Forever's launch they are a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle (toy), the Spectral Bear Cub (pet), the Spectral Bear Tabard and the Reins of the Spectral Bear (mount).

Los recolectaste %d veces en total.en: You gathered them %d times in all

Los talentos confirmados no se quitan gr.en: Confirmed talents can't be removed for free: check the list before accepting.

Los talentos que siguen en el plan no es.en: The plan's next talents aren't in your tree or can't be taken yet. Place them by hand in the game's talent window or pick another build.

Los tauren de Viento Libre viven en lo a.en: The Freewind tauren live atop the needles, linked by rope bridges, safe from the centaurs below.

Los tauren honran a la Madre Tierra. Dic.en: The tauren honor the Earth Mother. They say the sun and the moon are her eyes: An'she and Mu'sha.

Los tauren vivían como nómadas, acosados.en: The tauren lived as nomads, hounded by the centaurs, until Cairne Bloodhoof allied with Thrall. With the Horde's help they found their home in Mulgore.

Los titanes le dieron forma a Azeroth y.en: The titans shaped Azeroth and left guardians and cities, like Uldaman, to look after their work.

Los titanes usaron este cráter como un j.en: The titans used this crater as a testing garden for life; that's why there are dinosaurs and giant plants.

Los troggs huyen cuando tienen poca vida.en: Troggs flee at low health and bring friends: stop them before they get away.

Los troggs invadieron Gnomeregan, y los.en: The troggs invaded Gnomeregan, and the gnomes flooded their own city with radiation trying to drive them out. It was Mekgineer Thermaplugg's idea.

Los troggs salieron de las profundidades.en: The troggs came out of the depths of Uldaman. Everything suggests they're an ancient titan creation gone wrong.

Los trols Lanza Negra conocieron a Thral.en: The Darkspear trolls met Thrall on the islands where his fleet was wrecked on the way to Kalimdor. Their leader Sen'jin died there, and his son Vol'jin has led them ever since.

Los trols de estas tierras descienden de.en: The trolls of these lands descend from the Amani, the ancient forest troll empire. At Jintha'Alor they still raise their altars.

Los vendedores de suministros de pesca t.en: Fishing supplies vendors have poles, nightcrawlers and baubles.

Lugar conocido: el punto del rastreo del.en: Known location: the game's tracking dot tells whether something is there now.

Lya fue una gran perrita: noble, leal y.en: Lya was a wonderful little dog: noble, loyal and always beside her family, the chubby, pampered darling of the house. Alfa remembers her that way, as the she-wolf who looks after the pack and never leaves anyone behind.

Lya guarda la historia de cada misión qu.en: Lya saves the story of every quest you take, even if you accept it without reading. You follow the arrow: she remembers everything.

Lya se fue a descansar. Vuelve con /alfa.en: Lya went to rest. Bring her back with /alfa lya.

Lya se queda calladita una hora. Aquí si.en: Lya stays quiet for an hour. She's still here, looking after you.

Lya volvió. Dale clic cuando quieras un.en: Lya is back. Click her whenever you want a tip.

Lya vuelve a contarte sus consejos desde.en: Lya will tell you her tips again from the start.

Lánzalo antes de la siguiente pelea..en: Cast it before the next fight.

Maestría elemental: tu siguiente hechizo.en: Elemental Mastery: your next spell is a free critical.

Maldiciones y daño con el tiempo: pones.en: Curses and damage over time: you put your spells on and the monster dies on its own while you move to the next.

Maldición que hace cada vez más daño..en: A curse that deals more and more damage.

Malfurion Tempestira, el gran druida, es.en: Malfurion Stormrage, the great druid, is lost in the Emerald Dream, and Tyrande waits for him.

Mantén Furia recta encendida cuando tanq.en: Keep Righteous Fury on when you tank.

Mantén Grito de batalla siempre puesto..en: Keep Battle Shout up at all times.

Mantén Seccionar en el rival para que no.en: Keep Hamstring on your opponent so they can't flee.

Mantén al monstruo lejos: tu mascota lo.en: Keep the monster away: your pet holds it while you shoot.

Mar abierto y zonas de nivel 35 en adela.en: Open sea and zones of level 35 and up. Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh grants Artisan with his quest.
